## Dependencies

- Blocked by: U16 — Port core property, system, and peer checks must be complete.
- Unblocks: U20 — Enforce quality gates in CI and agent guidance must be complete.

## Files

Read split core `test/system/services/**` at the core baseline. Add `test/system/services/**` and its README. Change only test dependencies that are required by selected services. Change the manifest. Do not change `lib/**`.

## Instructions

1. Port each service family under the `:service` tag.
2. Use ephemeral services and test-only credentials.
3. List exact prerequisites and commands.
4. Defer a service when its required client is not part of the consolidated project.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Service checks do not run under `mix test`, `mix test.ci`, or `mix test.all`.
- [ ] Setup does not use ambient production services or credentials.
- [ ] Every service family has a manifest disposition.

## Verification

- Each documented `mix test.services` command exits with status `0` in its declared test environment.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
